subject: Operations
title: IoT and Connected Logistics
description: A micro-lesson that makes IoT and Connected Logistics usable.

hook.text: A vaccine shipment needs to stay below 8°C. An IoT sensor alerts the driver the moment the temperature rises.

buildup.text: IoT sensors track temperature, humidity, shock, and location in real time throughout the supply chain.

discovery.text: Connected devices generate data that feeds analytics, enabling proactive decisions instead of reactive fixes.

twist.text: IoT generates massive data volumes. Without analytics to process it, the data is noise, not insight.

climax.text: Maersk uses IoT on containers to track location and condition of goods across 100,000 ocean voyages a year.

punchline.text: Sensors see what humans miss. Data drives decisions.

quiz.question: What do IoT sensors in logistics track?
